body:
@projmgrauth
Set repo: /home/user/code/lisp/elmtui.lisp

Act autonomously through implementation, meaningful regression verification, checkpoint and typed phase result; do not stop at an audit or plan. Adopt/reserve/begin THIS EXACT OCP-bound packet before writes, use transactions and mandatory independent review; never self-approve. Read AGENTS.md, /home/user/code/org-roam-skill/SKILL.md and sexp-manipulator. Use parsed S-expression edits, reader validation and idiomatic Common Lisp (small composable functions, explicit protocols, conditions, no ad hoc sleeps or blanket warning suppression). SBCL commands MUST use clpm bundle exec --with-client sbcl -- regular-args. Preserve all dirty/untracked user/coordinator work, never reset/clean or rewrite history. No push/publication. Inspect current source, because ELMTUI-RELEASE-20261008 is concurrently modifying shared src/core/loop.lisp and src/pipeline.lisp. Coordinate on .wsbridge:release-20261008; request shared-runtime changes through that owner and continue independent example work. Own only listed example files, plus NEW narrowly named regression tests under tests/e2e/remainder-*; do NOT edit the common harness scripts/test-terminal-apps.py or existing native/bottom tests. Do not weaken assertions to claim green. Use actual ./examples.sh public launcher and real PTY/Xvfb input, not only mocked callbacks. Fixtures must never operate the host Wi-Fi. Keep input/render/exit bounded and startup stderr warning-clean.

Evidence: test-output/terminal-e2e-7e78324b/result.json (public-launcher full suite: five other example failures, four Wi-Fi tests pass). Wi-Fi regression gates: python scripts/test-terminal-apps.py --case wifi; same --terminal urxvt; python tests/e2e/test-bottom-row.py [--terminal urxvt]; python tests/e2e/test-native-urxvt.py; python scripts/test-startup-output.py. Native terminal proves actual CPR, screenshots and one-row scroll reservation/reversal. Latest passing artifacts after concurrent runtime edits: terminal-e2e-5af169fb and native-urxvt-e2e-b207e422. Preserve quiet launch, below-cursor placement, region-only clear, exact termios/cursor restoration, 20 separate one-row scroll steps/reverse, frame atomicity and subsecond keys. Report source changes, exact checks/results/skip counts, durable artifact paths, real proof versus missing proof. Submit for independent review; create an idempotent successor only for evidence-backed remaining work in this same scope. Shared core fixes and final release integration belong to existing ELMTUI-RELEASE-20261008, not these example lanes.

Task: ELMTUI-WIFI-ROBUSTNESS-20261008
Write scope: examples/wifi-menu.lisp

Finish Wi-Fi menu operation robustness. Independent review reproduced %browse-key-update starting another connection command when :busy t: BUSY-ENTER-COMMANDS=1. Guard duplicate Enter/r/d operations while busy, retaining immediate Escape/q abort and navigation as appropriate. Add black-box slow fake-nmcli test showing rapid Enter does not dispatch concurrent connections, abort removes menu promptly while operation pending and restores terminal; bound external command waiting and ensure subprocess cleanup is documented and tested. Do not introduce shell interpolation or expose passwords in argv/logs. Preserve all existing scanning, secure-password masking, quick keys, below-cursor scroll20x1, reverse cleanup, no whole-screen clear and quiet-startup gates. Current async nmcli scan %run-command has no explicit process deadline; investigate/repair only in this example with meaningful timeout/cancellation tests.
